name: drata-grc-skills
description: Drata GRC Assistant — 17 job-to-be-done skills plus a built-in help index (drata-help) over the Drata MCP, spanning audit readiness, controls, evidence, risk, third-party/vendor risk, workforce compliance, and stakeholder reporting. Every skill is named for the job: report to see it, identify-gaps to find what needs work, resolve-gaps to change it. Bring your own agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot).

output_mode.title: Output mode
output_mode.description: Drata deliverables render branded by default (Drata palette, Geist type, footer logo) as a designed artifact, or a delivered HTML file on hosts without artifacts. Set 'plain' to always get unbranded plain text instead. You can also just say 'text only' in any conversation.
